decks.notes: The main idea of this deck is to aggressively out-tempo the opponent through efficient card draw, removal spells, and powerful threats. By combining disruptive counterspells with versatile removal like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to control the early game while quickly deploying threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to close out the game. Using cards like Consider and Mishra's Bauble to cycle through the deck efficiently and quickly find key cards, this deck prioritizes speed and aggression to overwhelm opponents before they can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana and set up a quick win condition by playing spells such as Twiddle, Dream's Grip, and Recross the Paths to untap lands and manipulate the top of the deck. The combo revolves around using cards like Amulet of Vigor and Lotus Field to ramp up quickly and cast Goblin Charbelcher for a devastating finish. The deck aims to achieve a fast win without relying on traditional land drops, making it a unique and powerful combo archetype in the Modern format.

The deck focuses on early aggression and disruption by utilizing powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer, supported by effective removal like Fatal Push and Terminate. It also disrupts the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, while also being able to potentially lock out opponents with Blood Moon. The deck also has some graveyard recursion and card advantage engines with Dauthi Voidwalker and Feign Death. Overall, the deck aims to apply consistent pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, backed up by efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. It also includes a solid suite of counterspells and card selection tools to control the game and disrupt the opponent's plans. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistent access to spells. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain tempo throughout the game to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing a wide range of colors to support its aggro strategy, while also including a companion to provide additional benefits. It includes powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scion of Draco, as well as burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a mix of aggressive creatures and direct damage, capitalizing on the versatility that comes from being a 4/5c Aggro archetype.

The deck focuses on controlling the board with cards like Blood Moon and Karn, the Great Creator while ramping up mana with Utopia Sprawl and Arbor Elf. It utilizes powerful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Seasoned Pyromancer for pressure, while also having burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Fury for removal. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and establish its own strong board presence with cards like Wrenn and Six and Endurance. The mana base is built to support both red and green spells, with some land search and utility lands for added flexibility.

This deck focuses on using creatures with beneficial ETB effects and sacrificing them to tutor up key combo pieces with cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution. The deck also utilizes Yawgmoth, Thran Physician to generate value through sacrificing creatures and drawing cards. The toolbox nature of the deck allows for flexibility in finding answers to various threats while also setting up powerful synergy between cards like Strangleroot Geist and Young Wolf. The goal is to efficiently assemble the combo pieces needed to win the game while maintaining a strong board presence.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's strategy while quickly deploying threats to apply pressure. With cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate to disrupt the opponent's hand and board state, along with powerful aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer, this deck aims to quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Feign Death also add versatility and disruption to the game plan, giving the deck multiple angles of attack.

The deck focuses on cycling through creatures to fill the graveyard and then casting Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield at once. The key strategy is to self-mill or cycle cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will to set up a powerful, board-clearing combo. The deck also includes counter spells like Force of Negation to protect the combo and disruptive creatures like Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a massive, resurrected army of creatures while controlling the game with disruption and counter magic.

This deck aims to utilize a combination of creatures that can be searched and played at instant speed to create a powerful toolbox strategy. By using cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, it can find specific creatures like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide to generate value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes cards like Blood Artist and Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons to combo off and win the game. The mana base is designed to support the creatures and spells needed to pull off the combo effectively.

This deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures with abilities that work well together to create a powerful combo. By utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the deck can tutor for specific creatures to fit the situation. Cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Strangleroot Geist provide value and synergy with sacrificing creatures, while Grist, the Hunger Tide and Blood Artist can help drain the opponent's life total. The deck aims to generate incremental advantages through sacrificing creatures and recurring them to overwhelm the opponent.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to disrupt your opponent's strategy by countering their spells, removing their threats, and controlling the board through card advantage. By utilizing powerful counterspells, removal spells, and planeswalkers like Teferi, you can outvalue your opponent and eventually take control of the game. The deck also includes cards like Chalice of the Void and Leyline Binding to further disrupt your opponent's game plan. Ultimately, the goal of this deck is to outlast your opponent and win through attrition and control.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combo of Living End to quickly return all creatures from the graveyard to the battlefield. Key cards like Street Wraith, Architects of Will, and Violent Outburst help facilitate this combo while cards like Force of Negation and Subtlety provide protection and disruption. The deck also includes cards like Curator of Mysteries and Waker of Waves to provide additional value and card draw. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disrupt their game plan while setting up for a game-winning combo with Living End.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly assemble powerful equipment onto creatures, such as Colossus Hammer and Kaldra Compleat, using cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Puresteel Paladin. This enables fast, aggressive plays and can combo off to deal significant damage to the opponent in a short amount of time. The deck also utilizes cards like Sigarda's Aid and Urza's Saga to support this equipment strategy and protect against removal. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient equipment-based threats and combo potential.

The deck utilizes a toolbox of creatures to assemble a powerful combination of cards that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. It focuses on quickly ramping up mana production using cards like Wall of Roots and Arboreal Grazer, while also utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to tutor for specific creatures as needed. The deck aims to create a synergistic chain of creatures like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide to generate card advantage and control the board, ultimately leading to victory through a powerful and versatile combination of creatures.

The deck is centered around dealing damage quickly and efficiently, utilizing cheap burn spells and aggressive creatures to overwhelm the opponent. By combining direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Boros Charm with fast creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, the goal is to reduce the opponent's life total to zero as quickly as possible. Supporting cards like Searing Blaze and Roiling Vortex help control the board and prevent the opponent from stabilizing, making it a fast and aggressive deck that puts pressure on the opponent from the start.
